notes: All six pages are Columbia Business School 'Programs » Doctoral » Dissertations' listings filtered by ?year=; every copy is a Common Crawl capture (sourceUrl is the index lookup address, sourceDate the capture date). Each entry prints a dissertation title, 'Name, YYYY' and 'Faculty Advisor: X'; the page never states whether the year is the dissertation or the degree year, so yearMeaning is 'unstated' (the dissertations page is for the Doctoral Program, so these are doctoral dissertations, but no per-person degree label is printed, hence degree null and program 'Doctoral Program'). No placements or job titles appear. Pagination: each capture shows at most 10 entries; the 2015 captures of 2008 ('1 of 3'), 2009 ('1 of 2') and 2013 ('1 of 2') and the 2016 capture of 2010 ('1 of 2') show an 'Older items' pager, so further entries for those years were not captured; the ordering differs between captures and the two captures of the same year page list partly different people (for example 2008: 2015 capture has Philippe Mueller, Jaywon Lee, Rachael Elwork Wells; 2016 capture has Itai Gurvich, Jorge Murillo-Garza, Ricardo Montoya; 2010: 2015 capture has Andreas Stathopoulos, Margarita Tsoutsoura, Bugra Ozel, Qingyuan Yue; 2016 capture has Yongxiang Wang, Giselle Guzman, Aurelia Mok, Rebecca Levine; 2012: 2016 capture adds Dongyoup Lee, Olga Kuzmina, Damla Gunes and drops Helen Hurwitz, Matulya Bansal, Mehmet Saglam; 2013: 2016 capture adds Shinjinee Chattopadhyay). Integrator should treat the union across captures as still incomplete for 2008-2013. Double-check: (1) Woo-Jin Chang (advisor Partha Mohanram) is listed under both the 2009 page ('Woo-Jin Chang, 2009', title ending '...Following SFAS') and the 2010 page ('Woo-Jin Chang, 2010', title ending '...Following SFAS 158'); both rows kept as written. (2) The 2015 capture of the 2013 page lists Stephen Atlas twice with the same title but different advisors (Daniel Bartels and Eric Johnson); the 2016 capture lists him once with Eric Johnson; all rows kept as written. (3) On the 2008 page the title line reads 'Three Essays on the Pharmaceutical Industry Ariel Yaakov Fishman' (the fuller name appears inside the title field) while the name line reads 'Ariel Fishman'; the name was taken from the name line and the title copied as printed. (4) Entries lacking a 'Download Dissertation' link (for example Xiaozheng Wang 2009, Krista Schwarz 2010, Xiaojing Wang 2012) are still dissertation records. Names: these are business-school-wide dissertations across accounting, finance, marketing, management and decision/risk/operations; the operations-related entries (for example Omar Besbes, Itai Gurvich, Natalia Yankovic, Wei Ke, Mehmet Altug, Denis Saure, Min Wang, Matulya Bansal, Mehmet Saglam, Ahmet Simsek) are not labelled by division on the page, so program is recorded as the page's 'Doctoral Program' label only.
